title: Credentials written to the logs: a failed bloXroute call logs the axios error with the Authorization header, and an HTTP-level RPC error logged as err carries the RPC URL, where hosted RPC providers put the API key

evidence.note: relay transport failure: log.warn({ op: "bloxroute.relay.timeout", signedTxHash, attempt, err: relayErr })
health check failure: log.error({ err }) of the axios error
pino with no serializers and no redact option, so the default err serializer copies every enumerable property of the error
simulate failure logs { err: simErr } from provider.call

evidence.ref: node axios-log-repro.js and node rpc-url-log-repro2.js 500 (Node 22.16.0, scratch folder outside the repo; axios@1.10.0 CJS build and ethers@6.16.0 resolved through the repo package exports, pino@10.3.1 built with the src/utils/logger.ts options; loopback 127.0.0.1 only, fake sentinel values, no src/ import, no .env)
evidence.note: axios-log-repro: "log line contains AUTH-HEADER-SENTINEL: true" and "log line contains the signed tx payload: true" for an ECONNREFUSED relay call logged exactly as bloxroute.ts:186-189; rpc-url-log-repro2 with a loopback server answering HTTP 500: SERVER_ERROR and "log contains URL-KEY-SENTINEL: true"; for a JSON-RPC revert (CALL_EXCEPTION) and a refused connection the URL was not in the line

evidence.ref: node -e "const j=require('./.planning/baselines/safe01-offmachine.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({files_hit:j.scan.files_hit,exact_value_check:j.exact_value_check}))" (Node 22.16.0; baseline file last changed in 29cb750)
evidence.note: Context added 2026-11-07 at the 22-20 Task 3 close-out, supplied by the execute-phase orchestrator (not the operator, and not a check this executor ran on any log): the orchestrator listed file names only and found that the only persisted log files on disk are data/bot-capture-21-07.log, data/capture-21-07.log and data/capture-21-07b.log. The executor re-read .planning/baselines/safe01-offmachine.json: scan.files_hit names exactly those three files inside the backup archive, and the operator's D-22 exact-value check (22-03, run by the operator against the real .env with scripts/nac01-exact-value-check.ts, exit 0, result clean) returned "no" in both the backup folder and the archive for BLOXROUTE_AUTH_HEADER, ALCHEMY_URL, ETH_RPC_URL, BSC_RPC_URL, BASE_RPC_URL, ARB_RPC_URL, SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, ETH_FORK_RPC_URL, ETH_WS_URL and BSC_WS_URL; ARB_WS_URL and BASE_WS_URL are "unset" (present but empty in the .env), so they hold no value to leak; the archive is byte-identical to the Google Drive copy (bound_to_downloaded_bytes). So the backup copies of the persisted logs contain none of those exact values. Limits: it is an exact-string match of each whole value, made on the backup copies; terminal-only output that was never written to a file cannot be checked. No file under data/ was opened by the executor.
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Raw Axios errors can expose relay credentials and signed transactions

sibling_sites_checked: Every log call with an err field in the slice: bloxroute.ts:66, :140, :187; flashbots.ts:136, :247, :362; passthrough.ts:124, :147. The bloXroute ones carry the auth header (axios config); the ethers ones carry the RPC URL on HTTP-status errors (SERVER_ERROR). The Flashbots auth key itself is never logged (only its address, flashbots.ts:133, and per-body signatures). The wallet key is not logged anywhere in the slice; its presence on module-level CONFIG (provider.ts:59) is section C I1, owned by the config slice.
severity_rationale: S2 EXPOSURE: the trigger is ordinary (any relay outage, any 429/5xx from the RPC provider) and the leaked values are credentials (bloXroute auth header; the RPC provider key, which also leaks the operator's RPC quota and lets others read through the account). No funds can be moved with them, so it is not S1. Not tagged secret: no secret value was found; this is a code path that would write one. Whether existing logs already contain such lines was not checked (the capture logs live under data/, which audit plans must not read). Update 2026-11-07 (22-20 Task 3, orchestrator-supplied context; see the last evidence entry): the backup copies of the only persisted log files were covered by the operator's D-22 exact-value check and contain none of the bloXroute header or RPC/WS URL values; only terminal output that was never saved remains unchecked. Severity unchanged: the code path still writes these credentials on the next relay or RPC error.
recommendation: Phase 29 (card TX-04 for the log policy): add pino redact paths (err.config.headers.Authorization, err.config.data, err.request, err.info.requestUrl and similar) or log err.message/code only at these sites; decide on card TX-04 whether the operator should check existing log files and rotate the bloXroute header and RPC keys.
